title: IAT V2 dependency security triage

githubDefaultBranchSnapshot.note: This is GitHub's default-branch alert state. It includes alerts for an older pnpm-lock.yaml that is absent from the bound draft source and therefore is not interchangeable with the current npm lock audit.

decisions.subject: Do not run npm audit fix or bulk-upgrade launch dependencies
decisions.reason: Several suggested fixes are semver-major graph changes or apparent downgrades across Solana, Switchboard, Cloudflare, and Drizzle packages. Automatic mutation would be higher risk than source-bound review and targeted rehearsal.

decisions.subject: bigint-buffer has no upstream patched release in the captured Dependabot record
decisions.reason: The package is transitive through Solana buffer-layout tooling. Replacement or graph removal requires dependency-owner and reachability review; it is not safe to claim remediated by a suggested @solana/spl-token downgrade.

decisions.subject: Prioritize runtime reachability and supported upgrade paths
decisions.reason: The next safe increment is a source/import/bundle reachability matrix for the ten current-lock high findings, followed by supported upstream upgrades and a fresh Devnet rehearsal when protocol-facing packages change.

limitations: Advisory data is time-bound and may change after this capture.
npm audit reports dependency graph exposure; it does not by itself prove that vulnerable code is reachable in the production bundle or launch ceremony.
GitHub default-branch Dependabot totals and the bound draft package-lock audit cover different manifest states and must not be compared as if they were one scanner run.
No dependency was upgraded, downgraded, overridden, dismissed, deployed, signed, or broadcast by this audit increment.
